market_pulse.note: Closed down 1,101.11 points, or 2.19%, at 49,097.06 on Thursday, ending below 50,000 after Wednesday's 1.11% drop (Yahoo Finance).
Closed down 147.80 points, or 2.02%, at 7,175.83, a sixth straight losing session after an early gain of about 1% faded (Yahoo Finance; StockTitan).
Closed down 550.69 points, or 2.25%, at 23,879.20, reversing an early rally tied to Anthropic's debut (Yahoo Finance).
December futures were up $0.77, or 0.94%, at $83.08 late Thursday, recovering part of Wednesday's 3.2% slide; Middle East shipping attacks offset worries about a supply surplus (Yahoo Finance; RTÉ).

themes.title: Anthropic closes up 17% in debut
themes.summary: Anthropic opened at $111.50, 34% above its $83 IPO price after a record raise of about $81.3 billion, then closed at $97.17, up 17.07% (Yahoo Finance; StockTitan).

themes.title: Broad selloff, Dow loses 1,100 points
themes.summary: An early rally faded and all three major indexes fell about 2% or more; the VIX volatility index rose about 14% to near 28, among its highest levels since March (Yahoo Finance; StockTitan).

themes.title: AMD hit by short report
themes.summary: AMD fell roughly 8% to 9% after short seller Hunterbrook questioned its China ties; Nvidia, Broadcom and other AI names also declined (Yahoo Finance; StockTitan).

themes.title: Health care selloff extends
themes.summary: UnitedHealth fell about 5% to 5.5% as the rotation out of health care continued; Johnson & Johnson and Merck also slipped (Yahoo Finance; TokenPost; StockTitan).

themes.title: Walmart beats; data soft
themes.summary: Walmart reported revenue of $188.8 billion and raised its outlook but its stock slipped about 1%; the Philadelphia Fed index fell to 6.3 from 20.9 and jobless claims rose to 203,000 (Yahoo Finance; StockTitan).

sectors.name: Semiconductors / AI
sectors.note: Weak: AMD fell about 8% to 9%, and Nvidia, Broadcom, CoreWeave and Nebius were all lower in the afternoon (StockTitan; Yahoo Finance).

sectors.name: Health Care
sectors.note: Lower again, led by UnitedHealth's drop of about 5%, with Johnson & Johnson and Merck also down (Yahoo Finance; StockTitan).

sectors.name: Consumer / Retail
sectors.note: Consumer staples had the largest sector decline; Walmart slipped about 1% and Williams-Sonoma fell more than 13%, while PDD rose more than 10% (Eurasia Business News; StockTitan).

sectors.name: Energy
sectors.note: Oil rose about 1% after reports of tanker attacks near the Strait of Hormuz, following Wednesday's drop to its lowest since late August (RTÉ; Yahoo Finance).

watch_list.why: The stock closed well below its first trade and slipped about 1.5% after hours; its IPO sale is expected to close Friday, Nov. 20 (Yahoo Finance; StockTitan).
Intuit, Ross Stores and Gap were scheduled to report after Thursday's close (StockTitan).
Prediction markets price a high chance of a quarter-point rate increase at the December meeting (Ted Pillows; Altcoin Buzz).
